name: Quantum computing task: Implement the SWAP test in Qiskit to estimate |<psi|phi>
task_prompt: Quantum computing task: Implement the SWAP test in Qiskit to estimate |<psi|phi>|^2 between RY(2.031)|0> and RY(0.733)|0>. Compare the estimate from 16384 shots with the analytic overlap cos^2((2.031-0.733)/2). Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
